name: Momoyama Yuwata
source:
A hermit, who has been living for hundreds of years.
She's visiting the same school and the same year as Maho and is also in the broadcasting club.
At school, she has the image of an elegant lady but in private she is doing as her fits. Loves mayonnaise.
